buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Pre BID meeting will be held on 13 Nov 2026 at this unit loc (59 IBG EME UNIT, Panagarh) in physical att endance. All bidders are requested to attend the same before participating. 2. Certificate for self certification. Format as Appx'A'. 3. Scanned copy of 'Acceptance of Terms and condition of ATC' as format as Appx'B'. 4. All bidders should furnish proof of not being black listed in the past 06 Months. All bidders are required t o submit the same i.e. proof of not being blacklisted in past 6 months in 100 Rupees stamp paper. 5. All bidders claiming waiver in annual turnover or experience criteria should furnish documents as per D PIIT guidelines. 6. Payment of EMD is mandatory for all bidders except when the bidder is categorized as 'Manufacturing' in UDHYAM Certificate. Traders are not exempted EMD. 7. Warranty: The complete High Mast Lighting System shall be covered under a minimum 3-year compreh ensive on-site warranty from the date of successful installation and acceptance. 8. ePBG is mandatory for all bidders and the same to be completed before generating invoice. 9. Non disclosure agreement certificate to be submitted online by all bidders. 10. Supply, Installation & Commissioning: The successful bidder shall be responsible for the complete supp ly, installation, testing, commissioning, and handing over of the High Mast Lighting System in all respects. 11. Foundation & Civil Works: RCC foundation, anchor bolts, grouting, excavation, back filling, and all assoc iated civil works required for successful installation shall be included in the bidder's scope unless otherwis e specified. 12. Earthing & Lightning Protection: Proper earthing and lightning protection shall be provided in accordan ce with relevant IS/IEC standards. 13. Inspection & Acceptance: The buyer reserves the right to inspect the material before and after installation. Final acceptance Buyer's site. 14. Mandatory Documents: The successful bidder shall submit the following: Warranty Certificate, Test Cer tificates, Technical Datasheets, Installation & Commissioning Report, Operation & Maintenance Manual 15. Training: Basic operation and maintenance training shall be provided to the buyer personnel after com missioning at no additional cost. 16. After-Sales Service: Service support shall be provided within 48 hours of receipt of any complaint durin

g the warranty period. 17. Liquidated Damages: Delay in supply or commissioning shall attract Liquidated Damages (LD) as per G eM General Terms and Conditions/Contract. 18. Payment: Payment shall be released only after successful supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and acceptance by the consignee. 19. All bidders are also requested to submit the foundation drawings and drawings of high mast light tower latest by 1300 hrs on 16 Nov 2026. The above mentioned drawing has to be duly certified by an architect. In case of non- submission of drawings by any bidder is liable to be disqualified technically during technical evaluation stage only and no further representation will be entertained. 20. It has been noticed that in recent times that a few bidders have tried to spoil the bid. Hence, only the b idders whose rating is 4.5 and above on GeM portal will be accepted in technical evaluation. Bidders are re quired to submit self attested screenshot for the same. . 4. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 3 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 5. Warranty Over and above the normal Warranty terms as per GeM GTC, the successful bidder / OEM shall have to provide Comprehensive Warranty during the entire Standard warranty period as per contract. : The comprehensive warranty shall be covering the following scope AS per Technical Specification (Upload an undertaking with the bid confirming compliance by the bidder if Bidder is taking onus of this compliance. In case OEM is taking onus of this compliance, OEM undertaking is to be uploaded along with Bidder undertaking) 6. Warranty Successful bidder will have to ensure that adequate number of dedicated technical service personals / engineers are designated / deployed for attending to the Service Request in a time bound manner and for ensuring Timely Servicing / rectification of defects during warranty period, as per Service level agreement indicated in the relevant clause of the bid. 7.
